attributes_scope_product_valid.name: attributes_scope_product_valid
attributes_scope_product_valid.value:
(
        "attributes"."scope" = 'global'
        AND "attributes"."product_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "attributes"."scope" = 'custom'
        AND "attributes"."product_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

media_source_consistency.name: media_source_consistency
media_source_consistency.value:
(
        "media"."source_type" = 'upload'
        AND "media"."storage_provider" IS NOT NULL
        AND "media"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "media"."external_url" IS NULL
        AND "media"."mime_type" = 'image/webp'
        AND "media"."file_size" > 0
        AND "media"."width" > 0
        AND "media"."height" > 0
      ) OR (
        "media"."source_type" = 'external'
        AND "media"."storage_provider" IS NULL
        AND "media"."storage_key" IS NULL
        AND "media"."external_url" IS NOT NULL
        AND "media"."mime_type" IS NULL
        AND "media"."file_size" IS NULL
        AND "media"."width" IS NULL
        AND "media"."height" IS NULL
      )

variant_sale_price_valid.name: variant_sale_price_valid
variant_sale_price_valid.value:
"product_variants"."sale_price" IS NULL
        OR (
          "product_variants"."regular_price" IS NOT NULL
          AND "product_variants"."sale_price" >= 0
          AND "product_variants"."sale_price" <= "product_variants"."regular_price"
        )
